units.source_text: 第二日重开小宴，忙忙碌碌了一天。

en.t: The next day, a small banquet was held again, and everyone was busy for the entire day.

units.source_text: 源氏公子当筵弹筝，这小宴却比昨日的大宴富有雅趣。

en.t: Prince Genji played the koto at the gathering, and this small banquet had even more refined charm than the grand feast of the previous day.

units.source_text: 将近破晓，藤壶皇后进宫侍驾去了。

en.t: As dawn was drawing near, Empress Fujitsubo went into the palace to attend upon the emperor.

units.source_text: 源氏公子意兴阑珊，想起昨夜朦胧残月之下邂逅相逢的那个女子，

en.t: Prince Genji's spirits faded as he thought of the woman he had encountered by chance the previous night beneath the dim waning moon,

units.source_text: 此刻大约也要出宫返邸了，心中不胜怅惘。

en.t: and he supposed that by now she too would be leaving the palace and returning to her residence, which filled his heart with deep melancholy.

units.source_text: 便派他那两个精明能干的侍臣良清和惟光前去窥探情状。

en.t: He therefore sent his two clever and capable attendants, Yoshikiyo and Koremitsu, to go and find out what was happening.

units.source_text: 公子辞别皇上，出宫返邸之时，两人便来报告：

en.t: When the prince took leave of the emperor and was leaving the palace to return home, the two men came to report:

units.source_text: “以前停在隐蔽处的车子，现在已从北门出去了。

en.t: “The carriage that had earlier been parked in a hidden place has now gone out through the north gate.

units.source_text: 但见许多女御及更衣的娘家诸人中，右大臣家的两个儿子少将及右中弁匆匆忙忙地赶出来相送，

en.t: Among the many relatives of the ladies-in-waiting and court consorts, we saw the Minister of the Right's two sons, the Major Captain and the Right Middle Controller, hurry out to see them off,

units.source_text: 可知弘徽殿女御也退出了。

en.t: so it is clear that the Kokiden Consort has also withdrawn from the palace.

units.source_text: 我们看得清楚：其中不乏美貌女子。

en.t: We saw clearly that there were quite a few beautiful women among them.

units.source_text: 源氏公子听了这话，料想那女子一定在内，胸中不免激动。

en.t: When Prince Genji heard this, he imagined that the woman must surely be among them, and his heart could not help but stir with excitement.

units.source_text: 他想：“有何办法可以知道那女子排行第几呢？

en.t: He thought, “Is there any way to find out which daughter she is?

units.source_text: 索性将此事告知她父亲右大臣，正式做了他的女婿，是否使得？

en.t: Would it do to tell her father, the Minister of the Right, about this and formally become his son-in-law?

units.source_text: 但此人品质如何，尚未确悉，遽尔求婚，未免太孟浪吧。

en.t: But I still do not truly know what sort of person she is; to propose marriage so suddenly would surely be too rash.

units.source_text: 然而就此罢休，永远不知是谁，也太可惜，如何是好？”

en.t: Yet to give up now and never know who she is would be far too regrettable. What should I do?”

units.source_text: 他心中烦恼，茫然地躺着。

en.t: Troubled in his heart, he lay there in a daze.
